visualCharacteristics.purpose: dark boxed band of columns: intro beside link list, case study beside image, client video beside text, or a row of testimonials

contentPattern.structure: one row, two or more cells; each cell holds text, a list of links (rendered as arrowed rows), an image, or a lone YouTube/Vimeo link (rendered as an embedded player). With testimonials each cell is: quote-icon image, quote paragraph, attribution paragraph

usage: Practice-area intro with sub-service links, case studies, client success videos and testimonial rows on a dark band.
reuseGuidance: Use for content columns that sit inside a dark panel. Use columns-media for the same layouts on a light background.
